description: Capability for the Mod Manager plugin window (decision 0029). Deliberately narrower than capabilities/default.json for Tauri's own built-in plugin permissions: no opener, updater, or process access. IMPORTANT, see decision 0032: this file does NOT scope this app's own #[tauri::command]s (mods::*, list_games, launch_game, etc.) — this project has no permissions/ directory or command-ACL setup (bare tauri_build::build() in build.rs), so every command registered in generate_handler! is callable from any window today, this one included, regardless of what's listed below. The 'permissions' array here only fences off the three built-in Tauri plugins the main window gets (opener/updater/process) plus core:default. Real per-command containment for this window is a documented, deferred follow-up, not something this file currently provides — don't read its narrowness as proof mods:: commands are sandboxed from the rest of the app.
